transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you all know, our central chilled-water pump P-2 failed during the morning shift, and the affected production areas are currently without their normal cooling capacity. We have a scheduled batch in the reactor suite today, and the packaging area and utilities workshop also rely on chilled water. We need to discuss temporary cooling connections to bridge this gap until P-2 is back online. Before we proceed, I want to make sure we follow our standard protocol: we'll conduct a single pre-work review covering process, maintenance, and environmental health and safety findings. Before I close that review, I'll be asking each of the three functional leads to state any finding and documentation commitment relevant to the temporary connection. Let's get started.
